BTCUSD hits immediate resistance at $88k–$92k; a sustained break above that zone would open a path toward $100k and set a higher 2026 trading range

BTCUSD spot saw $384.71M in forced short coverings in 24h; largest single liquidation $11.29M on Binance (BTCUSDT) as automated buybacks hit the spot market.
